verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.text: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.

segments.text: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.

verses.text: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.

segments.text: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.

verses.text: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.

segments.text: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.

verses.text: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.

segments.text: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.

verses.text: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.

segments.text: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.

verses.text: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!

segments.text: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!

verses.text: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.

segments.text: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.

verses.text: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

segments.text: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

verses.text: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

segments.text: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.text: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

segments.text: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

verses.text: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.

segments.text: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
